general1.event: In StarClan, your job has never felt less important; there are no fights in paradise. What are you supposed to do?

general2.event: You listen attentively as r_c:0 confides in you about {PRONOUN/r_c:0/poss} fears of being forgotten.

general3.event: You sort out a dispute regarding a newly deceased warrior and their mate who had found another lover in the afterlife. In the end, they were able to agree on a polyamorous arrangement.

general4.event: A grudge never sorted in the living has found its way into the afterlife. You bring the two cats together to discuss the misunderstanding, and they are eventually able to reach a truce.

general5.event: The transition of a recently deceased cat into StarClan is oftentimes a difficult one, and it's your job to help them now. You can't help but feel a bittersweet pang in your heart for every soul that crosses the threshold, remembering your own first day here.

general6.event: You reassure another StarClan cat that this is all part of both their destinies as they watch a loved one mourn them.

general7.event: You rush to stop a dispute between two StarClan warriors formerly of rival Clans as tensions rise between their living Clanmates.
